fato_historico: 1966: The 23rd Street Fire in New York City kills 12 firefighters.
energia_do_dia: Today may invite a deep reflection on the resilience of the human spirit. Much like honoring those who bravely faced the shadows of the past to protect others, you are encouraged to guard your own inner flame. It is a good time to channel your empathy into strength, perhaps finding peace in the quiet bravery of your own heart.
frase_do_dia: Your gentle light holds the power to warm even the coldest of shadows today.
significado_numero: Represents the completion of a cycle and the wisdom of experience.
conselho: Honor your sensitive nature while standing firm in your personal truth today.
